curriculum.meaning: AIYL baseline/recovery release q01>=.05 and q99<=.98,.95,.90 respectively. Engineering targets, not biological measurements; no requirement that every neuron have midrange release.
curriculum.cue_direction: Either sign allowed and reported at this relay component stage, but same sign in both response half-windows, repeated cues and across all normal final cases. A relay decrease is not qualified RIAL inhibition.

criteria.gait: Unchanged E085 regional cycle amplitude preservation, absolute1.62..1.98Hz and5% relative frequency. Parabolic subsample median-period estimator from E086. Entire live embodied brain remains active; not a relay-only toy.
criteria.range: All uncued active/response/late and cued active windows satisfy q01>=.05/q99<=1-headroom. Cue response q01>=.005 and q99<=.995.
criteria.cue: Matched cue-minus-sham AIYL release means over response windows exceed headroom*.001 absolute with consistent sign across halves/repeats/variants. Continuous error targets margin; range, cue response and gait are jointly required, so merely lowering AIYL or changing baseline cannot qualify.
criteria.recovery: Cued active/baseline/recovery AIYL mean differs from matched no-cue by<=max(1e-6,.25*headroom*.001). Body baseline/recovery remains preserved.
criteria.selection: Only safe body-gait/recovery-preserving proposals can replace selected; operating-range failure does not prohibit retaining improving partial candidates. Advance after same-model low-dose/shift checks and common response direction; prefer highest validated rung for final.
criteria.controls: Eight final normal paired protocols: nominal,low-dose,shift,repeat,close-repeat,long-cue,neural-half,body-half. Chemical sensory block must remove response within.25*headroom*.001 while proprioception live.
criteria.numerical: Neural/body refined absolute response-statistic differences<=min(.005,.25*headroom)*.001 with all gait/relay gates. Endpoint1-abs(mean_release_change) is a reporting transport field, not a body amplitude ratio or fractional neural attenuation.
criteria.counterfactual: Final diagnostic ONLY: replay matched no-cue AIYL release onto its existing RIAL chemical edge from cue onset; all other neural/gap/NMJ pathways live. Includes matched no-cue replay. Body-effect mediation optional and separate; no clamp/forcing during fitting or normal validation.
criteria.claims: Only AIYL operating range/response component. Full motor stop/start/rest/restart, RIAL rhythm control, swimming/navigation and biological fidelity remain unqualified. No automatic downstream behavior promotion.

stimulus: Same E085 physical chemical bath, diacetyl1uM40..50s vs no-cue, NaCl50000uM baseline; low-dose.8uM, shifted/repeated/close-repeat/long schedules unchanged. No hidden cue labels or imposed oscillatory drive.
